text: Underway in round thirteen.
Flash immediately urging their partner forward to press the ball in midfield.
Right in front of goal, and it has squirmed inches wide of the mark!
Push-panel thumps it clear.
Spark loses balance completely on the left touchline, but the self-righting routine is already underway.
Flash is clean through here!
Spark comes across with a heavy shoulder to send Zhi sprawling on the right touchline.
Flash bundles it over the line from point-blank range! The league leaders strike first, one-nil to Gemini Flash FC!
Spark is calling for a strike from distance as the magenta ball rolls back to the centre circle.
Zhi equalises for GLM FC! Out of absolutely nowhere, tucked into the right corner from two metres out! One-all, game on!
Agonisingly close at the other end, shaving the woodwork on the left channel.
Gemini Flash FC are penning them in now, camping deep in the final third for the last seventeen seconds. GLM just cannot clear their lines.
Spark calls for the press again in midfield. Both these managers decided against tinkering this week, backing their setups entirely.
Spark drives straight through the middle.
And buries it! Spark restores the lead from right on the goal mouth! Two-one to the league leaders!
Pu breaks through the middle with only empty turf ahead!
Pu drives on towards goal!
Spark shouts to close the angle.
Just wide from Pu, a fraction away from levelling it once again.
Flash takes charge, carrying the ball seven metres up the left touchline.
Flash bursts right to the mouth!
And Flash finishes cleanly from two metres out! That is three-one to Gemini Flash FC.
Flash topples over in the centre circle, perfectly unaided, but will be back on their feet in a few moments.
Spark is clean through down the right!
And makes no mistake from two metres out! Spark rolls it into an empty net to make it four-one.
Total control now for Gemini Flash FC, hemming GLM deep inside their box.
Flash taps in another from close range. Five-one now, ruthless from the leaders.
Flash calls for immediate pressure straight off the restart.
The buzzer sounds, power cuts out, and the ball trickles harmlessly wide.
Power off at the buzzer, ball still live until it stops. A commanding five-one lead at the break for Gemini Flash FC.
Second half underway, and Pu carries the ball forward into the centre circle.
Spark takes possession, bringing it patiently across the middle third.
Drifts just wide of the post.
Flash pounces on the rebound and turns it in. Six-one now to Gemini Flash FC.
A clumsy collision between teammates, and Spark hits the deck.
Flash steps in to dispossess Pu with a firm challenge.
Spark loses balance again in the defensive third, down for eight seconds.
Zhi and Pu run into each other; GLM tripping over themselves.
Now Zhi goes over unaided, another eight seconds lost.
Flash calls out the shot, looking to pile on the misery.
Spark finds daylight on the right touchline with nobody in front.
Spark converts from the goal line. Seven-one to Gemini Flash FC.
Flash leaves Pu in a heap on the halfway line with another crisp tackle.
Flash tucks home from point-blank range once more. That makes it eight-one to Gemini Flash FC.
Flash calls for another effort on target from the right wing.
Spark flashes one across the face of goal, missing by less than a metre.
Spark prods in another from right under the crossbar. Nine-one now for the leaders.
GLM attempt a reply down the left channel, but it drifts wide.
Flash is heard scanning and tracking the ball.
Zhi gets loose on the right touchline.
Spark recovers well to put Zhi to the ground with a well-timed tackle.
Double figures for Gemini Flash FC. Spark slides it into the bottom corner for ten-one.
Spark knocks Zhi to the deck again in the centre circle.
Zhi returns the favour, sending Spark tumbling over in midfield.
Pu drives straight into the box.
Deflected off the post.
Pu stabs it home from two metres out! A consolation goal makes it
GLM managed to maintain a brief spell of pressure there before the restart.
Flash responds almost immediately from two metres out. Eleven-two to Gemini Flash FC.
The buzzer sounds, power is cut, and the ball slowly rolls through midfield.
Gemini Flash FC take it eleven-two. Up next, Codex City meet DeepSeek Rovers on Monday at midday UK time, one
